name: Jumping Jacks
description: A full-body warm-up exercise. Stand upright, then jump while spreading your legs and raising your arms overhead, and return to start. Repeat at a steady pace.

name: High Knees
description: Run in place while driving your knees up toward your chest as high as possible. Keeps the heart rate elevated.

name: Burpees
description: A full-body conditioning move combining a squat, plank, push-up, and jump. Demanding but highly effective.

name: Push Ups
description: Lower your body toward the floor by bending your elbows while keeping a straight line from head to heels, then push back up.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight-body position resting on your forearms and toes, keeping the core tight. Builds core stability.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: From a plank position, alternately drive each knee toward your chest in a running motion while keeping the core engaged.

name: Squats
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower your hips back and down as if sitting in a chair, then return to standing.

name: Lunges
description: Step forward and lower your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees, then push back to standing. Alternate legs.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with knees bent, then lift your hips toward the ceiling by squeezing your glutes, and lower slowly.

name: Hamstring Stretch
description: Sit or stand and reach toward your toes with a straight back to lengthen the muscles at the back of the thigh. Hold gently.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
description: On hands and knees, alternate between arching your back upward and dropping it down while moving the head. Improves spine mobility.

name: Wall Sit
description: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, holding the position. Builds leg endurance.

name: Marching in Place
description: Lift one knee at a time while standing, swinging the arms naturally. A gentle, low-impact starting exercise.
